title: What ASEAN Mediation Can and Cannot Do
summary: Melinda Martinus and Fannesa Adisty Laksmita argue that ASEAN’s strength lies in convening and facilitating dialogue but that without follow-through, different parties’ political will and sufficient leverage, its mediation efforts will struggle to deliver results.
